category_seo.title: DAO Governance Tokens - Voting Power & Tokenomics | BiuBiu Tools
category_seo.description: Explore DAO governance tokens. Voting mechanisms, token distribution, and governance participation across major DAOs.
category_seo.keywords: DAO governance tokens, DeFi voting, protocol governance, tokenomics, governance delegation

faqs.question: What are governance tokens?
faqs.answer: Governance tokens grant holders voting rights in protocol decisions. Examples: UNI (Uniswap), AAVE, COMP. Voting power is typically proportional to token holdings.

faqs.question: How does vote delegation work?
faqs.answer: You can delegate voting power to others (delegates) while retaining tokens. This helps active community members vote on behalf of passive holders.

faqs.question: Are governance tokens valuable?
faqs.answer: Value derives from governance rights, potential fee sharing, and speculation. Some protocols share revenue with token holders. Others struggle with value accrual.
